statement: A storage-reservation INSERT can commit while its answer is lost, after which the reservation owner blindly retries the same deterministic reservation_id and turns its own durable capacity hold into a UNIQUE failure. RebalanceCoordinator must converge through one existing mutation deadline on exactly one ACTIVE durable hold for the exact live replica_operations generation. A fresh insert reports CREATED; a proven exact pre-existing hold reports ALREADY_ACTIVE without duplicating creation events or statistics. Absent, terminal, mismatched, RELEASED, or EXPIRED authority fails closed. The durable admission-time estimated_bytes remains authoritative, and the current rule that an ACTIVE hold stays valid past expires_at while its exact operation is live is preserved.

constraints.statement: operation_id remains the reservation generation and reservation_id remains exactly res-${operationId}; no schema, generation, or alternate reservation identity is introduced.

Already-active adoption requires an authoritative non-terminal replica_operations row matching the supplied immutable operation identity and one exact ACTIVE reservation row matching the durable reservation identity, entity, partition, target, reason, amplification, and valid admission-time estimate.

Reservation insertion and lost-outcome reconciliation share the existing OPERATION_PERSIST_RETRY_TIMEOUT_MS or tighter caller budget; no nested deadline, new retry loop, timeout increase, or caller-side guard is added.

The persisted positive estimated_bytes is the admission-time authority and is not compared with a later estimate. An ACTIVE reservation remains adoptable past expires_at while its exact operation is live; RELEASED and EXPIRED rows never reactivate.

Only a newly applied insert increments reservationsCreated and emits reservationCreated. Adoption never duplicates either observation; the Quest does not claim exactly-once telemetry across an ambiguous answer.
An independent verifier reviews the exact final fingerprint after the last source attempt and records approve before landing.
